beats.narration_text: Hi, I am Deepa Shenoy, and this is my first progress update with Humanitarians AI. This is Liam, narrating for Deepa.

shot.visual_intent: Native HAI composer bookend. Greet Deepa; display Week 1 Progress / Introduction, @HumanitariansAI and AI narration: Liam for Deepa. Illustrative interface only, not a captured Claude session.

show.event: HAI composer bookend introduces Deepa and the week-one progress topic with explicit Liam narration disclosure.

props.command: Introduce Deepa's background and what she is learning through Brutalist
props.runningText: introducing Deepa's background and current learning focus

beats.narration_text: My background is in information systems, data engineering, data analytics, and business intelligence.

shot.visual_intent: Show the four fields as a clear typographic sequence. Do not imply a degree, employer, or years of experience.

show.event: Four supplied background areas appear in sequence.

beats.narration_text: My technical experience includes working with Python, SQL, Snowflake, Power BI, and Tableau.

shot.visual_intent: Typeset the five technologies as labeled tool cards; no logos, proficiency claims, or certification claims.

show.event: Python, SQL, Snowflake, Power BI, and Tableau are shown as named tools.

beats.narration_text: I have built data pipelines, analytics solutions, and dashboards. These are the kinds of tools and systems I bring to my work and learning.

shot.visual_intent: Abstract pipeline feeding an analytics view and dashboard, clearly framed as a conceptual illustration. No sample data or results.

show.event: Conceptual data pipeline, analytics solution, and dashboard connect without fabricated business data.

beats.narration_text: I am volunteering with Humanitarians AI and learning the Brutalist film-as-code workflow for educational STEM and AI content.

shot.visual_intent: Show HAI identity and a project folder becoming a video timeline. Keep @HumanitariansAI visible.

show.event: HAI identity appears beside the educational-content workflow.

beats.narration_text: The workflow combines structured planning, narration, visual storytelling, human review, and programmatic video production. In practice, that means shaping the idea, preparing narration, designing visuals, reviewing the cut, and producing the video through code.

shot.visual_intent: Five-step native workflow diagram: Plan → Narrate → Visualize → Human review → Programmatic production. Human review is visually distinct and remains a human decision.

show.event: Reveal the five workflow stages in order, with human review shown as a required decision point.

beats.narration_text: My current focus is learning the workflow and using my technical background to communicate STEM and AI concepts clearly. I am learning how the planning, narration, visuals, and review fit together.

shot.visual_intent: Bring the workflow stages together into one educational-video frame; center the stated focus on clear STEM/AI communication. No result or mastery claim.

show.event: Planning, narration, visuals, and review resolve into a single educational video.

beats.narration_text: This is the beginning of my work with Humanitarians AI, and I look forward to sharing what I learn and build along the way.

shot.visual_intent: Hold Deepa's name and the HAI identity as the supplied closing statement lands. Do not add a milestone or outcome.

show.event: Deepa Shenoy and @HumanitariansAI remain legible during the exact supplied closing.

beats.narration_text: Week one progress and introduction. Liam, narrating for Deepa, for Humanitarians AI.

shot.visual_intent: Native HAI title-restating outro adapted from Deepa's approved 99% Accuracy close. Display Deepa Shenoy, AI narration: Liam for Deepa, @HumanitariansAI and the full HAI mark. No Bear identity. Exact canonical AUTHOR.MD wording is unavailable in this checkout and remains for human review.

show.event: HAI title-restating card closes the video with Deepa credit, AI-narrator disclosure, channel handle, and HAI mark.
